learning_objective: The learner will differentiate six causes of an embedding result by choosing the cause that each of six test reports describes, with at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt.
specification:
Type: microsim **sim-id:** embed-failure-diagnoser
**Library:** p5.js
**Status:** Specified
**Bloom Level:** Analyze
**Bloom Verb:** differentiate
**Learning Objective:** The learner will differentiate six causes of an embedding result by choosing the cause that each of six test reports describes, with at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt. **Prerequisites:** Iframe Embedding, No-Login Access, Responsive Layout, Embeddable Component (defined in Chapter 9) (all defined above this block or in Chapter 9). **Evidence of Mastery:** For each report the learner commits one of six causes. A choice is correct when it matches the Correct cause column in Content. Mastery is at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt. Reading the cause list is exploration, not evidence. **Misconceptions:** (1) A blank frame always means the file is missing. (2) If the page works on its own, it will embed. (3) A sign-in form in the frame is a platform error. **Instructional Rationale:** Differentiating among causes is an Analyze-level action, because the learner must read the evidence in a report and decide which cause fits it. Six reports that look alike on the surface teach the learner to read the details. **Content:** The six causes: Frame blocked by the host, Insecure address in a secure page, Needs a login, Script path broken, Layout not responsive, Works. The six reports: | # | Test report shown to the learner | Correct cause | Why (shown as feedback) | |---|---|---|---| | 1 | The frame stays blank, and the browser's message says the page refused to be displayed in a frame. | Frame blocked by the host | The server told browsers not to show the page inside a frame. | | 2 | The frame is blank on a secure page, and the simulation's address begins with http and not https. | Insecure address in a secure page | A browser refuses to mix an insecure frame into a secure page. | | 3 | The frame shows a sign-in form. | Needs a login | The resource requires an account, so it cannot embed for visitors. | | 4 | The page loads, the buttons do nothing, and the browser's message says a script file was not found. | Script path broken | The page loads a script by a path that does not exist at the new location. | | 5 | The frame shows the simulation, and every control responds. | Works | The embed passed. | | 6 | The simulation appears, and on a phone the right side is cut off. | Layout not responsive | The page has a fixed width and does not adapt to the frame. | **Provenance:** The reports are illustrative cases written for this chapter, and the sim labels them "illustrative examples". The causes follow the chapter sections "Iframe Embedding", "No-Login Access", and "Responsive Layout". **Rules:** Each report has exactly one correct cause, and the six causes are all different. **Learner Activity:** 1. The learner reads one test report and sees the six causes. 2. The learner chooses a cause, and the choice is committed. 3. The sim shows whether it was correct and the Why text. 4. After report 6 the sim shows the summary. **Feedback:** 6 reports in a shuffled order, one attempt each. Correct: "Correct: [cause]. [Why]". Incorrect: "Not quite. The cause is [cause]. [Why]". The summary shows "[n] of 6 correct on the first attempt". At 5 or more it adds "You can read an embed test." Below 5 it lists the Why text of each missed report. **Starting State:** The first report and the six causes. The question shown is "What explains this result?" **Chapter Anchors:** The chapter says an embed can fail because the host blocks frames, because an insecure address is shown in a secure page, because a login is required, or because the layout is fixed, and the sim adds a broken script path.
